headline: Nvidia deepens Korea ties with gigawatt AI build plans
body: A quiet day. Nvidia announced memory co-development with SK hynix, and NAVER plans to scale its AI infrastructure in South Korea from 55MW to gigawatt level. More compute adds to Capability Velocity, slightly lifting Enslaved God and Descendants and lowering Reversion. Horizon Balance is 2.9, down 0.03.
movers_note: Reversion -0.1, mostly from the Nvidia-Korea news (-0.12). Conquerors +0.08, from the Nvidia-Korea news (+0.10), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.02). Enslaved God +0.07, from the Nvidia-Korea news (+0.12), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05).
